title: Chirurgie des surfaces conformes : notes manuscrites (s.d., 1983-1984), lettres (1984).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting (from the previous page): X is a punctured conformal surface of type (g,nu). X* is a surface with nu boundary circles. Earlier Grothendieck explains how X is recovered from X* by 'capping the holes with canonical disks', which re-establishes the conformal structure across the components of the boundary of X*. A system of disks (D_i) around the punctures of X that arises this way is called 'admissible'. Question 8 asks how admissibility shows up in the intrinsic geometry of X, for instance in relation to geodesic disks dist(x,a_i) <= r_i for the canonical metric.

On this page he fixes a reference oriented topological surface of type (g,nu) and introduces the 'Teichmüller space with boundary' TB_{g,nu}. This is the Teichmüller space of compact bordered Riemann surfaces of genus g with nu boundary circles. The boundaries are unparametrised, so the space is finite-dimensional. He first wrote 'isomorphic' to R^{6g-6+3nu', then corrected it to 'homeomorphic'.

The dimension count is correct:
- Via the Schottky double (genus 2g+nu-1, real points of its Teichmüller space): 3(2g+nu-1)-3 = 6g-6+3nu.
- Via Fenchel-Nielsen coordinates: 3g-3+nu interior curves give lengths and twists, plus nu boundary lengths.

He prefers the description C^{3g-3+nu} x R^nu. Here C^{3g-3+nu} stands for T_{g,nu} (complex dimension 3g-3+nu; homeomorphic to a ball, not biholomorphic to C^n). R^nu stands for one real 'size/gauge' parameter per hole.

He then considers the capping map TB_{g,nu} -> T_{g,nu}. It glues a canonical punctured disk into each hole, the puncture being the centre. He 'presumes' this map is a fibration, more precisely the canonical projection C^{3g-3+nu} x R^nu -> C^{3g-3+nu}. He crossed out a 'x R^nu' after T_{g,nu}, which shows him fixing the target as the punctured Teichmüller space.

His heuristic justification is local, via pants decomposition:
- Take a holomorphic sphere with three holes, type (0,3), with its combinatorial model fixed.
- Vary only one, two or three of the gauge parameters attached to the three holes.
- The resulting 'bordered and punctured' sphere (one, two or three punctures according to the case) should stay conformally the same.
- The next page continues: it is obtained 'by bordering the corresponding pinces', each capping disk D(l_i) depending only on its own l_i.

The outcome, stated on the next page, is that for a fixed punctured hyperbolic surface the admissible disk families (D_i) form a space homeomorphic to R^nu ('infinity^d possible openings'). This leads to a Conjecture that (D_i) -> (sigma(D_i)) gives such a parametrisation.

The page thus belongs to a programme of 'surgery of conformal surfaces': cut a conformal surface along a pants decomposition, attach canonical disks or cusps, and describe the moduli of bordered surfaces as a product of punctured moduli and boundary parameters.

A plausible modern reading of 'canonical capping': the hyperbolic metric with geodesic boundary gives each boundary circle a parametrisation by arclength, canonical up to rotation. One can then glue a standard punctured disk canonically. The fibre over X is then the set of disk systems D_i such that harmonic measure on the boundary of D_i seen from a_i matches the normalised hyperbolic-geodesic-boundary arclength on the boundary of X minus the union of the D_i.
errors: Writing T_{g,nu} 'simeq C^{3g-3+nu}' (and TB simeq C^{3g-3+nu} x R^nu) can only mean a homeomorphism or real-analytic diffeomorphism. Teichmüller space is a bounded domain, not biholomorphic to C^n; his own correction 'isom.' -> 'homéo.' shows he is aware.

The claim that capping is a trivial fibration is explicitly a presumption ('je présume'). The supporting argument is only heuristic: it relies on an unproved 'gauge independence' for pairs of pants, and the next page admits it would need to be seen clearly.

The canonicity of the capping depends on a choice of boundary parametrisation, which is not made explicit on this page. Bordered Teichmüller points carry no boundary parametrisation, so some canonical (e.g. hyperbolic-arclength) choice is implicitly required.
On the previous page, 'métrique de Bergman canonique' for the hyperbolic case presumably means the Poincaré (hyperbolic) metric; the Bergman metric of a compact surface is a different object.
None substantive in the dimension counts, which are correct.

ideas.what: Teichmüller space of bordered Riemann surfaces TB_{g,nu}, of real dimension 6g-6+3nu, viewed as C^{3g-3+nu} x R^nu
ideas.modern_name: Teichmüller space of bordered surfaces / of hyperbolic surfaces with geodesic boundary (Fenchel-Nielsen coordinates incl. boundary lengths)
ideas.where_published: Pants decompositions and the Teichmüller tower appear in Esquisse d'un programme (1984); the bordered version is not, to my knowledge, made explicit there

ideas.what: Canonical capping map TB_{g,nu} -> T_{g,nu} conjectured to be a trivial fibration with fibre R^nu (one real 'gauge' parameter per hole)
ideas.modern_name: Close to Penner's decorated Teichmüller space T x R_+^nu (horocycle decorations) and to the Harer-Mumford-Thurston/Bowditch-Epstein identification of T_{g,nu} x R_+^nu with metric ribbon graphs; also to sewing/capping in Segal-Vafa-Huang CFT moduli

ideas.what: Heuristic local argument via pairs of pants with fixed combinatorial model: varying the gauge parameter of one hole does not change the conformal type obtained by capping the others
ideas.modern_name: Locality of capping in a pants decomposition (pants gluing / Fenchel-Nielsen locality)

ideas.what: Admissible disk systems around the punctures of a fixed punctured surface form a space homeomorphic to R^nu (stated on the next page)
ideas.modern_name: Analogue of horodisk / horocycle decorations, or of the Strebel residue parameters a_i
ideas.usually_credited_to: Penner (decorated Teichmüller theory); Strebel (quadratic differentials with prescribed residues)

missed.claim: Grothendieck proposes a precise, canonically defined 'hole-capping' map from bordered to punctured Teichmüller space. He conjectures it is globally the product projection C^{3g-3+nu} x R^nu -> C^{3g-3+nu}, with fibre the space of 'admissible' disk systems around the punctures. As far as I know, this specific conformal capping and its triviality have not been formulated or proved in this form. The later theory uses instead horocycles (Penner) or Strebel differentials, where the product structure is built in by construction.
missed.quote: Considérons l'application TB_{g,ν} → T_{g,ν} de bouchage des trous, je présume qu'elle est fibrante de façon plus précise, que c'est la projection canonique.
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: It gives an intrinsically conformal (not horocyclic) decoration of punctured surfaces. Comparing it with Penner's decorated Teichmüller space, Kontsevich-Penner ribbon-graph coordinates, and boundary-parametrised moduli in CFT (Huang, Radnell-Schippers) could yield a new canonical trivialisation. It also bears on Grothendieck's own question of how admissible disks relate to geodesic disks or horodisks.

missed.claim: In 1983-84, Grothendieck independently arrives at the idea that 'punctured moduli x R^nu' parametrises bordered or decorated surfaces through a combinatorial (pants/trajectory) model with gauge parameters per hole. This predates or is contemporaneous with Harer, Penner and Bowditch-Epstein. It links his 'chirurgie des surfaces conformes' and the Teichmüller tower of the Esquisse to decorated Teichmüller theory.
missed.quote: ou mieux, : C^{3g-3+ν} × R^ν ... paramètres "de jauge" correspondants aux trois trous
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: Historically, this documents Grothendieck's independent route toward cell decompositions of moduli space. Mathematically, it suggests a pants-local (Lego/Teichmüller-tower) proof of the product structure, a viewpoint the ribbon-graph literature did not take.

deep.surprise_reason: The bordered Teichmüller space and its dimension are classical. The conjectured canonical trivialisation via conformal capping, with fibre R^nu of 'admissible disks', is an unpublished and somewhat original formulation. It anticipates the decorated Teichmüller / T x R^nu circle of ideas, but those ideas were developed independently and soon after, so a specialist would find it interesting rather than startling.
transcription_corrections: At the start of line 3, before TB_{g,ν}, there is a struck-out symbol (looks like a crossed 'T' with subscript R or similar). It is not a live 'R[?]' and should be marked as deleted.
The second diagram row reads: under TB_{g,ν}: '≃ C^{3g-3+ν} × R^ν'; under T_{g,ν}: 'C^{3g-3+ν}' with '× R^ν' struck out. The transcription is essentially right but should be rendered as two columns.

'je présume qu'elle est fibrante de façon plus précise, que {+c'est la projection+} [-deux pts du-] canonique' — the insertion reads 'c'est la projection' above the struck 'deux pts du'. The sense is 'that it is the canonical projection'.
'quand la modèle[?] combinatoire' should read 'quand le modèle combinatoire'.
'paramètres "de jauge"' — this reading seems right; the [?] can be removed.
The last line appears to begin with 'triponctuée' or 'tri-ponctuation'. The final inserted word above the struck text appears to be 'conjuguée'.
